scope: WP5 LUCiD runner: cells/cohorts, cached generation, per-cell independent training, probes/floors/verdicts, development cohort, smoke and scaling (runbook v4 §3.5.3-§3.5.9, §6.1-§6.2)

training.gradient_accumulation: auto: one micro-batch of 32 fits the §6.2 caps per WP4c (~2.8 GiB at batch 32 on CPU); use --micro-batch/--accum-steps if a host profile says otherwise, keeping the effective batch at 32
training.optimizer_frozen_by: docs/jepa/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-18 'frozen LUCiD training numerics (Lead decision)': mirror the already-frozen WP4 convention in src/jepa_noise/configs/bridge_v1.json:281-322 (AdamW lr 1e-3, betas (0.9, 0.999), weight decay 0, eps 1e-8, fused on CUDA with the documented CPU fallback; Muon lr 1e-3, momentum 0.95, nesterov, ns_steps 5), constant learning rate, no warmup, no decay, grad clip null, batch 32, 10 000 steps, fp32/TF32 off. The runner applies these and refuses any other schedule.

optimizer_detail.fused_note: repository convention is fused=True; the CPU-only local environment uses the documented fallback fused=False. The run manifest records the device and the fused flag actually used.
optimizer_detail.numerics_frozen: AdamW(lr, betas, eps, weight_decay, fused policy) and Muon(lr, momentum, nesterov, ns_steps) are frozen; no outcome-dependent tuning is allowed; the schedule is an implemented no-op (constant, no warmup, no decay).

smoke_optimizer.label: engineering_smoke_only_not_registered
smoke_optimizer.note: Fallback spec used only when a deliberately pending_review config is passed with allow_pending=True (tests/diagnostics). After the 2026-10-18 freeze, smoke uses the frozen numerics like every other run; it remains non-registered because of its synthetic geometry and reduced steps.

steps_5000.note: §3.5.6 budget fallback step 3: 5 000 steps instead of 10 000; accepted by load_run_config and recorded as a non-primary run (registered=false), never a silent replacement.

seeds_3.note: §3.5.6 budget fallback step 1: 3 seeds for every main arm; accepted by load_run_config and recorded as a non-primary run (registered=false).

fallbacks.recorded_in: docs/jepa/DECISIONS.md (each fallback step must be recorded there when activated)

main.s_p_note: §3.5.3 registers s_p = 0.05 adjusted only through §3.5.3a; the 2026-10-17 check raised it to 0.10 on the superseded run that treated F3 as known, so on 2026-10-18 the ladder restarted from the registered default 0.05 and may raise it to 0.10 only at step 3

r11.note: §3.5.6 item 1: F1 (s = 0.05, carried by the F2 law), F2 (a = 0.50, frozen) and F3 vary independently

r11b.note: §3.5.6 item 2: trained on law R11b (one co-varying scalar, s = 0.05, attenuation a = 0.50) plus F3; probes fitted/scored on independent R11-law probe sets

dark_anchor.note: §3.5.6 item 3: the dark-window-only anchor at s = 0.10, 3 seeds

law_t.note: §3.5.6 item 4: law T plus F3, r/R = r/100 for r = 0..99; in-range probe sets + r/R in [1.9, 2.1] extrapolation

occupancy.note: §3.5.6 item 5: LeJEPA (= sigreg_jepa) within, s = 0.05, natural vs balanced context views, 3 seeds

development.beta_rule: §3.5.6: the largest beta whose vertex resolution is <= 1.1 x the development sigreg_jepa; one seed per beta; none qualifying -> none_qualified
development.physics_probe_rule: §3.5.6 step 2: if the linear vertex resolution of BOTH development encoders is worse than 3 x the reference fit, the primary physics probe becomes an MLP (2 hidden layers of 256, early stopping on 10% of probe-train, fixed seed)

data.storage: one directory per (cohort, law, setting, dataset seed) with the generator's per-run hits.npz/twin_hits.npz/events.npz/manifest.json/SHA256SUMS and a dataset-level manifest.json; cached and verified, never regenerated silently

dark_noise.method: noise_module_lucid.readout.dark_noise_window(params, n_channels, seed=, run=, window=), keyed on the dark_window:<window> stream
dark_noise.note: PMT R-6 turns dark counts on, so the bank is a real dark-noise-only draw (no source photons): ~2 dark hits per WCTE-sized record against ~900 source hits per physics event. The anchor overlays one record per perturbed copy; R7b is evaluable again and is reported together with the dark-only draw's measured embedding change.
dark_noise.readout_params: the generator's bound R-6 values (1 kHz per PMT, window [-200, 800] ns, SPE sigma 0.3, threshold 0.25 PE, charge domain [0.25, 1000]) plus the fixed per-module parity charge gain and digit timing-width factor

data.probe_event_id_reuse: the single registered 10k probe ranges are reused across drift settings (same event IDs, keyed draws -> identical vertices/yields); each setting has its own dataset directory and state hashes
data.train_loader: each 32-event batch draws 4 events from each of 8 runs chosen without replacement, so no batch comes from a single run and every event has equal probability
data.verify_on_reuse: manifest and per-run state hashes; SHA256SUMS verified only with --verify-hashes

views.probe_loader: probe sets are tokenised with n_min = 0: the N_min exclusion applies to training events only (DECISIONS WP4c)

evaluation.floors: the same probe on an untrained encoder of the same architecture, init seed = the arm's first seed; cached per (arm, cell) because it does not depend on the training seed
evaluation.physics_reference: noise_module_lucid.consequence.fit_vertex (default FitConfig unless a reference.json v_group is named); recorded charges/times, no gain correction
evaluation.physics_reference_status: not_available_locally: the PMT reference.json/SHA and the repaired readout are pending (§3.5.2); resolution fields are not_evaluable until named

criteria.seed_floor: §3.5.8: for arms a and b, max(SD_a, SD_b, median SD over all arms in that cell); cross-cell (R6): max(SD_cell_a, SD_cell_b, larger median SD of the two cells); claim only if |delta mean| > 2 x floor

r6.within_excess_rule: within excess over floor > 2 x the within-cell seed floor (floor = max(SD_within, median SD over arms in the within cell)); reading flagged to the Lead

r11b.rule: at least one R11 condition fails on the R11-law probe sets

r12.requires: F3 detectability pass AND R6 pass
r12.s_scope: both splits at every R6-eligible s (reading flagged)

scaling.note: no training; synthetic layouts on a cylinder surface; forward+backward of the context encoder + predictor; a size that exceeds the cap or raises OOM is recorded as does_not_fit

hosts.smoke_and_scaling_2k_10k: Deepthought (4 x GTX Titan 12 GB, 40 cores)
hosts.guard: scripts/jepa_guard.py; one job per GPU; fp32 with TF32 disabled

unresolved_questions: Secondary cells with s_p = 0: runbook §3.5.3 gives F3 s_p = 0.05 adjusted only through §3.5.3a, and the frozen check set s_p = 0.10 for every LUCiD cell (including R11, R11b and T). No s_p = 0 cell is registered; none is created here.

R12 is not a separate training cell: it is a control evaluated on the main cells, evaluable only if F3 passes §3.5.3a and R6 passes. F3 failed the frozen check, so R12 is not_evaluable and no R12 cell is trained.

No single-GPU per job 'write-once control' exists in §3.5.6. The five secondary items are R11, R11b, dark-window-only anchor, aging trend and occupancy ablation; a write-once control/cell is not defined and is not implemented.

Development-cohort step 4 (robustness seed selection) is not in §3.5.6. The runbook fixes three dev steps and 17 dev trainings (2 probe-decision + 15 beta); step 4 is refused and referred to the Lead.

The per-event vs run-mean probe-form decision with a 1.2x CRLB ratio and a 1.1x expected-SE criterion is not in §3.5.6. The runbook fixes run_mean as the primary form for every registered criterion and dev step 2 as the physics-probe type (ridge vs MLP at 3x the reference fit). That rule is not implemented.

R6's within-excess 'seed floor' is not spelled out; the runner uses the within-cell §3.5.8 floor and records it. R12's 'both splits' does not name s; the runner reads both splits at every R6-eligible s (0.05, 0.10). Both readings need confirmation.

Probe sets reuse the single registered 10k probe-train/probe-test event-ID ranges across drift settings (distinct dataset directories and state hashes). If disjoint ranges per setting are intended, the runbook does not name them.
The physics reference v_group from reference.json is not available locally (PMT branch pending); until a path is named the reference resolution is not_evaluable.

R11/R11b: the criterion does not name a probe form; the runner uses run_mean per the §3.5.9 preamble ('all LUCiD detector-state R2 values are run-mean') and the seed-mean leakage (each seed's value recorded).
The occupancy ablation's arm label 'LeJEPA' is read as sigreg_jepa on natural-vs-balanced context views; the natural-view baseline is the main s = 0.05 within cell.

The mae_chi2 covariance needs one cell spread s; law T's module-gain spread scales with r/R and the runbook fixes no single s. The runner passes s = 0.10 (T_SPREAD) for the law-T cell and s = 0.05 for R11b; both readings need confirmation.

ijepa_ema target-encoder input (reported, not patched): lucid_arms.py:469-480 feeds the EMA target encoder the full input and gathers the masked target tokens, while v3 WP4 line 233 asks for the masked target-token input. The fix is inside lucid_arms.py, which is outside the WP5 runner fix's file scope; it is reported to the Lead and no silent patch is applied.
